title: Card visual (data, rendered by static/js/visuals.js)
description: Every chart and diagram is data. Prices are explicit numbers; nothing is drawn by hand. Tones: up, down, gold, sky, muted, white, primary, pro, coral, amber, blue.

pos.description: label above or below the dot (default: above, unless too close to the top)

path.description: waypoints [[candle index, close], …]: closes pass exactly through them; candles between get a seeded wiggle

n.description: path: number of candles (default last waypoint + 1)

seed.description: path: change it to get a different (still deterministic) wiggle

future.description: empty candle slots on the right (room for a trendline to extend)

axisRoom.description: keep a 24px column on the right even without the price axis

priceLabel.description: small label above the price area ("Price"), used with panels

volume.description: volume per candle (right-aligned to the candles); draws a volume panel under the price

volAvg.description: dashed average line in the volume panel

overlays.description: lines on the price scale: a moving average (`period`, computed from the closes) or explicit `values` (right-aligned, null = gap)

touches.description: candle indexes where the line is touched: numbered rings 1, 2, 3

trendlines.description: straight lines [index, price] → [index, price]; extend right by default

chip.description: extra text on the walk-through button

swings.description: swing points (HH, HL, $45 …): a dot and a small label. In a walk-through each is a tap.

zigzag.description: true (or a tone name): join the swings with a line

vlines.description: vertical dashed event lines (8:30 jobs report)

extra.description: prices to keep inside the scale

explore.description: walk-through tap mode (default: zones, else swings, else 2+ hlines, else play)

items.description: Indicator panel under the price: rsi (0–100, 30/70 bands; values or computed from closes with period, default 14) · macd (macd/signal/hist arrays, or computed 12/26/9) · line (any oscillator: values, levels)

chart.description: A candlestick price chart. Give `ohlc` (explicit candles) OR `path` (waypoints → generated candles). Everything else is optional.

compare.description: Two side-by-side outcome tiles, each with a mini chart and a result line (e.g. market vs limit).

book.description: Order book / price ladder. depth 0–1 draws the size bar.

rows.description: A receipt / working box: label–value rows.

style.description: levels: one toned pill per row (Target / Entry / Stop)

tiles.description: Tap-to-open tiles. `open` = indexes open in the rendered (end) state of a walk-through.

flow.description: Boxes in a row joined by arrows (a sequence of deals, a borrow-sell-buy cycle…).

open.description: rows layout: the bar shown selected at first

slider.description: Interactive slider. model selects the formula: tug (buyers vs sellers → price), longshort (price → long/short P&L), leverage (move % → P&L on margin), size (position size → loss on a gap).

counter.description: A grid of dots that fills a jar (e.g. $1 a night × 90 nights).

ad.description: An app/ad mock: a phone card with a promo badge.

icon.description: set on every item: toned cards with ✓ / ✕ / !

stack.description: Two or more visuals stacked (e.g. a chart and a receipt).

line.description: One line chart in a card: title + change on top, start/end labels on the line, an optional tag row (e.g. a headline). Give `ohlc` to draw real candles with a price axis (preferred); `points` draws the old line.

fmt.description: candles: decimals on the price axis

drop.description: The move drawn on the chart: a dashed line at the start level, a bracket to the end and this label (e.g. −5%).

days.description: Labels under the points after the first (the open).

lines.description: Two small line charts: stacked with a big label (layout stack) or side by side (layout pair). Items with `ohlc` draw candles; `lo`/`hi` give them one shared scale.

scale.description: own: each item's line fills its own box (the shape matters); shared (default): one scale for all items.

ticket.description: An order ticket: BUY · 10 shares · $50.00 · Seller ?

position.description: A position line from a trading app: label, what you bought, value now and change.

bullbear.description: The two camps: a card each (a mini candlestick chart via `chart`, or an image via `img`), name, tag and one line.

ladder.description: A low-to-high scale (gradient line) and one row per tier.

quotes.description: Bid · Spread · Ask boxes, with an optional head (title, toll badge, sub).

handshake.description: B ——— Last trade $50.00 ——— S: the last deal between a buyer and a seller.

series.description: Line chart of non-price values (an account, a portfolio, fees over 20 years, correlation). Prices are candles, never a series.

trades.description: One bar per trade around zero: wins up (green), losses down (red).

barchart.description: Grouped columns (negatives hang below zero). A group with a `note` is tapped to show it.

hbars.description: Horizontal bars. layout stacked: label + value above a full-width meter. value2 on any row: two bars per row (a fall | the gain to get back).

split.description: 100% bars: one row per bar, segments sized by value (an allocation, a portfolio by stock, costs vs profit).

donut.description: An allocation ring with a legend.

table.description: Rows of cells under an optional header. A cell: text, or {text, tone, badge, strong, sub}. A row with `note` is tapped to show it.

gauge.description: A scale with bands: bar (RSI 0–30–70–100 with a marker) or arc (a dial with a needle: fear · calm · greed).

cycle.description: A smooth curve with labelled points (the emotion cycle, the economic cycle). t = 0–1 along the curve.

units.description: A grid of small squares (100 shares, 5 of them yours; 40 markets).

rr.description: Trade plan: reward box (entry → target, green) over risk box (stop → entry, red), with +$ / −$ labels. compact for two tiles side by side.

calendar.description: An economic calendar: day · time · event · impact badge.

list.description: Numbered rules or steps: numbers (one box), cards (a box each), chain (toned boxes joined by ↓).

checklist.description: Yes/no checklist. In a walk-through each answered check is tapped to show ✓ / ✕.

planbar.description: My Trading Plan tracker: Section n of 5.

stats.description: Tiles: label, big value, sub line (or a dot title + text). arrow: two tiles joined by →.

formula.description: Formula as toned chips joined by operators.

candle.description: One to three big candles with Open/High/Low/Close callouts. labels: text per price, "?" (asked, gold) or false (hidden). axis: a price grid instead of callouts.

shapes.description: Candle patterns as small glyph tiles (hammer · doji · engulfing).

tabs.description: A static timeframe switcher (1m · 1H · 1D · 1W) with one tab on.

drawline.description: Candles with a line the learner drags into place. trend: handles at start.from / start.to candles, fitted when both are within tolerance of the target line. level: one horizontal line, fitted at target.price ± tolerance or inside target.min–max.

lineshapes.description: Price shapes as one simple line per tile, the name in the line's colour (design P1-Ch04-L1, L4).

depth.description: Compact order book: price, $ of orders, a bar, ask/bid on the best levels; asks first.

sessions.description: When markets trade on one 24-hour day: a row per market, bands for its hours, a shaded busy window, an optional live now line.

crowd.description: Buyers against sellers at one price, counted as people.

stacks.description: Money as stacked bars with a dashed arrow between stacks.
